claim_boundary: This is a read-only post-formal localization on the two frozen development seeds 1901 and 1902. It may identify the minimal v2 mechanism target, but it is not v2 confirmation, may not fit a probe or readout, and may not access formal seeds.

estimands: retained direct correctness at A, J, and H
paired J-minus-A and H-minus-J direct-correctness transitions
direct-minus-remote correctness and absolute-magnitude specificity at all three stages
H_greater_A.interpretation: negative A localizes the wrong sign to bound operator value generation; positive A followed by negative J localizes corruption to the operating point; positive A and J followed by negative H localizes corruption to finite-amplitude expression

decision_tree.aggregate_A_J_H_all_aligned: correct semantic direction reaches actual policy; quantify amplitude and local-global combination without adding a memory store, and do not call it sufficient without a frozen human-scale comparison
decision_tree.aggregate_A_J_H_all_opposed_or_unresolve: storage and access are present but correctness-aligned value semantics are not; v2 should add a relation-specific value-generation transformation while preserving the operator substrate
decision_tree.aggregate_A_aligned_then_J_lost_or_rever: operator value is correctness-aligned but the recurrent operating point corrupts its semantics; v2 should preserve fidelity through local recurrent expression
decision_tree.aggregate_A_and_J_aligned_then_H_lost_or: linearized local expression is correctness-aligned but finite-amplitude nonlinearity corrupts it; v2 should modify nonlinear routing or expression
decision_tree.aggregate_aligned_but_H_greater_A_oppose: a single scalar local correction is insufficient; v2 requires relation-conditioned semantic transformation
decision_tree.mixed_across_seeds_or_stages: preserve the heterogeneous result and register a narrower discriminator; do not select relations, subjects, or checkpoints
decision_tree.raw_decrease_without_rho_degradation: the transition is attenuation rather than semantic corruption

directional_rules.local_specificity: direct-minus-remote correctness and direct-minus-remote absolute residual magnitude bootstrap lower bounds both exceed zero
directional_rules.raw_attenuation_only: raw direct correctness decreases while the rho contrast is unresolved and the downstream stage remains correctness-aligned
directional_rules.semantic_degradation: the paired downstream-minus-upstream rho bootstrap upper bound is below zero
directional_rules.semantic_improvement: the paired downstream-minus-upstream rho bootstrap lower bound is above zero
directional_rules.stage_correctness_aligned: both direct-correctness and rho bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero
directional_rules.stage_correctness_opposed: both direct-correctness and rho bootstrap upper bounds are below zero

hodge_semantics.correctness_sign: y_e is the registered true-order sign for canonical edge e
hodge_semantics.direct_correctness: d_X(q,s) = y_q C_q^X(q) for retained relation q
hodge_semantics.direct_edge: the canonical edge corresponding to support relation q
hodge_semantics.edge_order: all 28 canonical item-index pairs from itertools.combinations(range(8),2)
hodge_semantics.gradient_projector: Q is the registered complete-graph edge-space gradient projector
hodge_semantics.locality_control: d_X(q,s) - r_X(q,s), accompanied by direct-minus-remote absolute residual magnitude
hodge_semantics.remote_correctness: r_X(q,s) is the mean y_e C_q^X(e) over the 15 remote edges
hodge_semantics.remote_edges: the 15 query edges disjoint from both endpoints of q
hodge_semantics.residual_field: C_q^X = (I-Q) F_q^X independently for every relation, subject, and stage X
hodge_semantics.stable_omission_control: all A, J, H scalar fields and Hodge residuals must be zero within tolerance when q was already omitted for subject s

nested_maps.fixed_output_covector: w_out = W_out[action1] - W_out[action0], used at its trained scale with no normalization or refit
nested_maps.local_jacobian: J_b = diag[1 - tanh(b)^2] evaluated at the relation-LOO baseline
nested_maps.loo_baseline: b_(q,e,o) = i2h(x1) + [W + alpha elementwise-multiplied by P_T,without-q] h0_(e,o)
nested_maps.oriented_scalar_field: F_q^X(e) = 0.5 * [w_out^T X_(q,e,forward) - w_out^T X_(q,e,reverse)] for X in {A,J,H}
nested_maps.query_key: h0_(e,o) is the step-0 hidden state of oriented query edge e with hidden reset to zero

normalized_semantics.bootstrap_unit: virtual subject after averaging raw retained relation effects within subject; rho is first computed within subject
normalized_semantics.non_equivalence_rule: an interval containing zero is unresolved, not evidence of preservation, absence, or equivalence
normalized_semantics.purpose: rho distinguishes semantic direction from raw amplitude; a common positive rescaling changes direct correctness but not rho
normalized_semantics.subject_level_rho: for each subject and stage, cosine between the vector of retained direct residual values C_q^X(q) and their correctness signs y_q
normalized_semantics.undefined_rule: rho is undefined only if the retained direct residual vector has norm at or below scientific_zero_tolerance
